newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff says 150 temp workers detained.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff says 150 temp workers detained.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc said Wednesday that about 150 temporary employees it supplied to a packaging plant were detained by the U.S. Immigration and Naturalization Service.

The company, which called it an "isolated incident," said in a statement that those employees "apparently used bogus Social Security cards and other false identification to obtain employment" at AccuStaff.
The temporary workers had been placed at packaging plant in Butler, Ohio. Earlier in the day, Chesapeake Corp said the employees had been assigned to one of its facilities.
AccuStaff said it was cooperating with the INS and would provide those employees' records to the agency.
The company said that all of the temporary employment positions have been restaffed, and it expects no financial effect.
